en: A sepia-toned postcard showing an aerial view of a European town square featuring a prominent building with a clock tower. The caption at the top reads 'Döbeln i. Sa. Rathaus.' The square is surrounded by historic buildings, and there are people walking in the plaza below. The architectural style is consistent with Central European cities, and there are visible tram tracks in the square.
